turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. My son learned about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so start by telling me who decided that, and when.
Don't thank me, Hale. I asked you a question. Who entered that zero, and did anyone hear from Owen before it went in?
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.

You still haven't said whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in, and your own procedure says that comes first. Fine, show me the version history, with the dates on it. Turn the screen so I can read it myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and your confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your written answer by end of day Thursday, November 12.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, agreed to nothing.
Moved at: none
